brief.text: The full comparison covers 105 questions across 26 meetings; final accuracy and latency results are pending.
Duplex-only runs compare the same requests with no earlier discussion, four minutes of history and all earlier audio.
S2 compares reactive answers, summaries, accumulated structured notes and compact source notes with the full transcript held fixed.
The timing test measures actual post-request response time separately from thinking-token counts.
